name: data-extract
description: Extracts structured data (numbers, percentages, entities) from the LLM answer using deterministic regex patterns. Also returns ONE bare value via a first/last/max/min/sum selector, or a precise /regex/ capture — ideal for a flow decision node.
author: TDA Core Team

parameters.description: A type filter (numbers/percentages/entities), a scalar selector (first/last/max/min/sum → one bare number), or a /regex/ capture (first group, coerced to a number when numeric).
